items.title: Meta's new AI device changes everything
items.summary: Everyone's talking about the meteoric rise of Meta's Muse, but Zuck's real power move dropped a day later: a secretive, keychain-sized AI device with a camera and mic, shipped months ahead of OpenAI's rumored rival. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down the Muse Charm news from Qualcomm's Snapdragon Summit in Hawaii, and unpacks the biggest stories of the week from Meta Connect and beyond.

items.title: Titans of Tech Attend State Dinner Honoring China’s Xi
items.summary: Amazon’s Jeff Bezos, Meta’s Mark Zuckerberg and Nvidia’s Jensen Huang were among the dozens of CEOs invited to President Trump’s state dinner in Washington, D.C., on Thursday to honor China’s Xi Jinping.

items.title: Options Say Marvell Stock Could Halve Or Nearly Double In A Year
items.summary: Marvell Technology (MRVL) shares trade near $261, and its options price a one-year range of about $133 to about $514. In plain terms, a rough but ordinary year from here could leave the stock at roughly half today's price or nearly double it. Yet that range is still calmer than the ride holders had over the past twelve months.
